errors.text_span: 组内左侧带有向右上倾斜斜线纹理的白色柱子代表“本文方法”，右侧带有向右下倾斜斜线纹理的灰色柱子代表“基线模型”
errors.evidence: Description reverses the visual attributes: the lighter (white) bars represent '本文方法' and the darker (gray) bars represent '基线模型', not the left/right positioning or slant direction.

errors.text_span: 在“远”类别中，“本文方法”约为58.9%
errors.evidence: The figure shows the '本文方法' F1 value for '远' is approximately 59%, not 58.9%.

errors.text_span: “基线模型”的柱子为全图最短，近似值为56.2%
errors.evidence: The figure shows the '基线模型' F1 value for '远' is approximately 56%, not 56.2%.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart as comparing F1 scores of two methods across three distance categories.
The description does not mention the legend position (right upper corner).

errors.text_span: 图表中的水平类别按距离的自然逻辑顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description introduces an interpretation ('自然逻辑顺序') not explicitly supported by the figure or atoms.

errors.text_span: 垂直坐标轴为数值轴，标签为“F1 (%)”，采用线性缩放，数值范围从52到62，均匀刻度间隔为2，单位为百分比。
errors.evidence: The description redundantly specifies '单位为百分比' after the axis label already includes '%'.

errors.text_span: “近”类别中“本文方法”的柱子为全图最长，近似值为59.3%，“基线模型”约为59.0%
errors.evidence: The phrase '柱子为全图最长' is misleading as the '本文方法' bar for '远' is not the longest in the entire chart.
